description: The learning forge — durable lessons from execution.
learning_questions: What broke or slowed this release?
What proof was missing until late?
Which gate should become automatic next time?
Which human approval should remain explicit?

testr.note: How this product is proven. Sibling of shipr. Does not run tests.

purpose: CLI + razor-thin MCP for LESSON-NNNN records. Commit .lessons/. First ship is GitHub only — PyPI stays an explicit approval gate.

related_testr.note: When present, testr test_commands become shipr proof_commands

rollback_paths: revert the commit on main; no production service to roll back. Yank only after a future PyPI release.
